mapper.select: SELECT fo.order_id, fo.status, fo.actual_total, fo.freight_amount, fo.total, fo.pay_type, fo.pay_time, aui.name as userName, aui.phone as userPhone, fpa.addr as addrName, fpa.mobile as mobile, fpa.addr as addr, fd.dvy_name as dvyName, fo.dvy_flow_id as dvyFlowId, fd.dvy_addr as dvyAddr, fo.remarks FROM folwer_order as fo left join applet_user_information aui on fo.user_id = aui.user_id left join folwer_delivery fd on fo.dvy_id = fd.dvy_id left join folwer_pick_addr fpa on fo.addr_order_id = fpa.addr_id where fo.order_id = #{orderId}
